title: Lexicography Saves Lives (LSL): Automatically Translating Suicide-Related Language

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating machine translation quality (adequacy, fluency, and spelling errors) of an English suicide-related lexicon translated into 200 languages to identify performance disparities between high-resource and low-resource languages.

Conducting human evaluations using 'Cultural Acceptability' and 'Context' metrics to determine if directly translated English suicide-related expressions (e.g., idioms or metaphors) are meaningful, valid, and actually used within the target culture's context.
